title: A Current for the Trail
author: Edmund Dunmore
blurb: Theo Ashgrove, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, has spent seven years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
